title: Fast Model Debias with Machine Unlearning
findings: The proposed debiasing method (FMD) was tested on BERT and GPT-2 for religious bias using the StereoSet benchmark. For GPT-2, the method achieved the best Stereotype Score (58.43, where the ideal is 50), indicating it was the most effective at reducing stereotypical associations in the religion category compared to baselines. For BERT, its performance was competitive with other debiasing methods.
